title: A risky change waits for a person
summary: A database migration is routed to a human, and its PR waits for a review.

steps.title: Ask for a database change
steps.narration: Schema changes are risky: they touch production data and must work with the old and new code at the same time.

args.title: Add an index on orders.customer_id
args.body:
Listing a customer's orders is slow. Add an EF Core migration that creates an index on `orders.customer_id`.

_Opened by the demo console risky-change scenario._

steps.title: Triage routes it to a human
steps.narration: The triager scores it high risk because it adds a migration, and labels it needs-human.

failOn.subject: issue#{issue}
failOn.description: Triage gave it to an agent

steps.title: A person hands it to the agent anyway
steps.narration: The presenter assigns the issue to the agent in GitHub. The agent writes the migration and opens a PR, but it cannot merge it on its own.

wait.description: A PR for the migration issue is opened

steps.title: The PR waits for a review
steps.narration: CODEOWNERS covers migrations, so a person has to approve the PR before the merge queue will take it. Here it is, waiting.
